Single source of truth for Codex fidelity and command tiers. Multi-agent families require BOTH PARITY_EVIDENCE (behavioral, runtime.tests.test_codex_parity) AND a resolvable native_subagent_dispatch runtime primitive (COMMAND_RUNTIME_PRIMITIVES) before promotion to native. Exported .codex/agents/*.toml is not primitive evidence.

Emits .omp/config.yml plus OMP package/discovery layout under .omp/z-harness/; returns ExportResult(fidelity='native') after T009. Must not reuse pi export rewrites. .omp/config.yml is never modified.

Native OMP dispatch driver (T007): frozen argv/prompt-transport/event/session/model contract. Separate from scripts/omp-consult.sh. Rejects empty prompts; normalizes events; redacts secrets from telemetry.

native.description: Full orchestration + native personas. All /z-* commands run identically to the Claude Code reference. Multi-agent dispatch (subagents, panels, consults, gates) works natively.

partial.description: Adapter/export support implemented but parity not yet proven. Codex export currently sits here because native SKILL.md/custom-agent/MCP artifacts are emitted while runtime command orchestration remains flattened/degraded/blocked. OMP advanced from partial to native via T009.

high.description: Native skills/personas, single-agent only. Multi-agent commands (/z-execute, /z-panel, /z-consult, /z-gate) are degraded (single-agent transliteration, not blocked). All other /z-* commands run at native fidelity.

flattened.description: Transliterated rules, single-agent only. z-harness rules injected via host-native config file. Single-agent /z-* commands run in degraded mode. Multi-agent commands are blocked.

curated.description: Export-only. Curated rule/steering files with host-specific frontmatter (trigger for Windsurf, inclusion for Kiro). No adapter, no launch/inject. Export via runtime.drivers.<host>.export only.

pointer.description: Export-only. Single pointer/instructions file pointing to z-harness capabilities. No adapter, no launch/inject. Export via runtime.drivers.<host>.export only.

app_plugin_multi_agent_support.evidence_source: codex features list row for multi_agent
app_plugin_multi_agent_support.claim_boundary: App/plugin multi-agent evidence only; not proof that codex exec exposes CLI agent dispatch.

cli_visible_agent_support.evidence_source: codex exec --help agent/subagent flags or commands
cli_visible_agent_support.claim_boundary: Required before treating Codex CLI as a native subagent-dispatch candidate.

ask_user_gate_support.claim_boundary: Required before mapping z-harness gates onto Codex CLI.

event_frame_support.claim_boundary: Required before preserving native Codex event frames in the runtime driver.

codex_capability_contract.promotion_rule: support_tier summarizes probe evidence only. Command-family promotion still requires the relevant CLI fields plus codex_parity_gate.py PARITY_EVIDENCE AND the native_subagent_dispatch runtime primitive; app/plugin multi-agent support must not be conflated with Codex CLI support.

codex_parity_gate_contract.promotion_rule: A multi-agent family promotes to native only when BOTH its PARITY_EVIDENCE entries resolve AND the native_subagent_dispatch runtime primitive resolves (COMMAND_RUNTIME_PRIMITIVES). Non-multi-agent families with resolvable PARITY_EVIDENCE promote directly; unlisted families stay degraded. codex_adapter_fidelity()=native requires ALL native-candidate families proven plus ADAPTER_EVIDENCE; codex_export_fidelity()=native additionally requires EXPORT_EVIDENCE. As of this refresh none resolve (all evidence modules/classes absent), so codex stays flattened/partial/blocked as shipped.
codex_parity_gate_contract.explicitly_rejected_evidence: Exported .codex/agents/*.toml files and the current interactive session's own subagent tools are NOT accepted as native_subagent_dispatch evidence.

codex_mcp_hardening.mismatch_behavior: codex mcp remove <server_name> then codex mcp add ... (full re-registration), not a silent skip
codex_mcp_hardening.post_add_toml_patch: codex mcp add has no CLI flag for default_tools_approval_mode/enabled_tools/disabled_tools; mcp.py patches those direct keys into [mcp_servers.<server_name>] surgically after add succeeds

exported_mcp_surface.rationale: Codex's /z-* command surface is native plugin skills, not MCP tool calls; MCP is intentionally narrowed to a lightweight detection helper so a skill run cannot recursively invoke z-harness command tools over MCP

claude.stage1: none — native plugin reads skills/<id>/SKILL.md directly
claude.note: skills/ is the committed source; no export to files is needed or done on the native host

cursor.note: skills are written verbatim (no transliteration); z-harness-skills.mdc is the only generated always-apply .mdc index; AGENT rules use .cursor/rules/<id>.mdc; export artifacts are never committed

codex.note: skills written as native SKILL.md under export root; custom-agent TOML written under .codex/agents; discovered by .codex-plugin/plugin.json 'skills' key; MCP config narrowed to enabled_tools=['z_detect'], default_tools_approval_mode='approve'; AGENTS.md remains fallback/reference; export artifacts are never committed

omp.note: OMP export is native first-class host support: adapter/export fidelity are native, z-execute/z-consult/z-gate/z-panel are native, all other command families are degraded; not pi export and not omp-consult provider compatibility.

Post-add TOML patch handles approval_mode/tool filters (no CLI flag). Exported surface narrowed to enabled_tools=['z_detect'], default_tools_approval_mode='approve'.

Codex export fidelity is partial because export evidence resolves independently. Probe support_tier is evidence for later parity work and does not promote COMMAND_CAPABILITY_MATRIX by itself.
capability_probe.surface_split: app_plugin_multi_agent_support is distinct from cli_visible_agent_support, ask_user_gate_support, and event_frame_support.

command_tiers.note: Multi-agent commands are degraded on high-fidelity adapter hosts and blocked on flattened adapter hosts. Export-only hosts (pi/windsurf/kiro/cline/copilot) have no command-tier registration — they are not in the adapter registry. OMP command tiers (T009): z-execute/z-consult/z-gate/z-panel are native; all others are degraded. Codex command tiers are gate-driven via codex_parity_gate.py's tier_provider: multi-agent families need PARITY_EVIDENCE AND the native_subagent_dispatch primitive; other families promote on PARITY_EVIDENCE alone; unlisted families stay degraded. KNOWN_COMMANDS includes z-resume alongside the other 15 families.

per_tier.curated: export-only — no command tiers; not in adapter registry
per_tier.pointer: export-only — no command tiers; not in adapter registry

command_tiers.codex_note: Codex parity gate is conservative by design: as shipped, none of PARITY_EVIDENCE, ADAPTER_EVIDENCE, EXPORT_EVIDENCE, or the native_subagent_dispatch runtime-primitive evidence resolve, so codex stays adapter=flattened, export=partial, multi-agent families=blocked, other families=degraded.

Codex export fidelity is partial: native SKILL.md files, custom-agent TOML, plugin manifest, AGENTS.md fallback/reference, and MCP config are emitted, but Codex CLI command orchestration remains flattened/degraded/blocked.

Claude Code is the ground-truth parity target for OMP and Codex native behavior.

.omp/config.yml intentionally preserves skills.enableAgentsProject=false; native OMP discovery is explicit through OMP_PLUGIN_ROOT and the .omp/z-harness package.
pi is export-only even though its export result fidelity is high; it is not in the adapter registry and is not a native OMP stepping stone.

Codex MCP registration (runtime/drivers/codex/mcp.py) is idempotent against full desired state (command/args/env/enabled_tools/disabled_tools/default_tools_approval_mode); a mismatch triggers codex mcp remove then codex mcp add, never a silent no-op with stale config

codex multi-agent promotion needs TWO independent gate resolutions (command PARITY_EVIDENCE + native_subagent_dispatch runtime primitive) — check codex_command_decision(command).reason for which one is missing, do not assume a resolved PARITY_EVIDENCE entry alone promotes the family

cursor and the Codex CLI adapter both declare adapter fidelity=flattened but differ in MCP surface: cursor has supports_user_mcp=True, codex does not. Codex partial export fidelity and app/plugin probe evidence must not be substituted for CLI command parity.
antigravity uses ANTIGRAVITY_PLUGIN_ROOT; all three other adapters inject CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT
codex MCP registration is global (~/.codex/config.toml) and survives session cleanup; explicit removal only via z-harness doctor --clear-mcp
codex MCP idempotency check now compares full desired state, not just key presence — a hand-edited or stale [mcp_servers.z-harness] entry triggers remove+re-add, not a silent skip
codex mcp add has no flag for default_tools_approval_mode/enabled_tools/disabled_tools; mcp.py patches those TOML keys directly post-add — do not assume codex mcp add persists them

the exported Codex MCP surface is deliberately narrow (enabled_tools=['z_detect']) — Codex does not get the full z-harness MCP tool set because its /z-* commands run through native plugin skills instead
cursor needs_trust_prompt=True means inject() must not assume non-interactive; surface the prompt via PTY
canonical adapter order in registry remains claude > antigravity > cursor > codex > omp, but prod auto-selection is filtered/sorted by release_surface.public_release_hosts(): claude, omp, codex
register_command_tiers() raises ValueError at import time if KNOWN_COMMANDS entry is missing — misconfigured adapters fail fast; KNOWN_COMMANDS includes z-resume

antigravity collision domain is workflows/rules/skills stems (with z-harness- prefix stripped from rules); cursor uses .cursor/rules/ stems; codex persona collision checks use prompts/ stems only (AGENTS.md and .codex/agents are excluded)
windsurf/kiro/cline/copilot are NOT adapters: registry.select(<host>) raises UnknownHostError for them; z_harness_cli/adapters/ has no module for them
Do not treat omp-gemini/omp-codex provider entries as native OMP host support; they are consult-provider compatibility through scripts/omp-consult.sh.
OMP command tiers start blocked/degraded until command-family evidence covers the matrix; a host-wide native label is forbidden before the parity gate.

command_tier() and register_command_tiers() now support a tier_provider callable (COMMAND_CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS); COMMAND_CAPABILITY_MATRIX alone is a stale snapshot for omp/codex — always read command_tier(host, cmd), never index the matrix dict directly for gated hosts

release_surface is a separate concept (runtime/release_surface.py) that registry.select() now consults for prod auto-selection filtering — do not conflate its prod/dev visibility rules with this concept's adapter fidelity tiers

dispatch.prompt_transport: final positional argv argument; do not rely on stdin in print mode
dispatch.empty_prompt: reject before spawn with a driver error
dispatch.output: assistant text to stdout result; stderr preserved separately; non-zero or empty required output becomes error with exit code and bounded stderr summary
dispatch.secret_rule: payloads enumerate fields explicitly and never log full env/config dumps, OAuth tokens, or raw model credential material
dispatch.session_rules_profile_model: native mode keeps rules enabled through OMP_PLUGIN_ROOT, preserves requested sessions, passes profile/model explicitly, and redacts those values from telemetry; consult mode is the only --no-rules --no-session path

discovery_export_layout.config_outcome: .omp/config.yml keeps skills.enableAgentsProject: false to avoid auto-loading the large root AGENTS.md; native discovery is explicit via package root

boundaries.legacy_pi_export: do not call runtime/drivers/pi/export.py, pi prompt rewrites, scripts/pi_assets, or vendored pi subagent extension
boundaries.omp_consult: scripts/omp-consult.sh remains provider-registry compatibility only and intentionally uses --no-rules --no-session

pi.note: No HostAdapter, no HostDriver, no --host pi, no launch/inject; not evidence for OMP native parity.

drift_verification.command: source review of z_harness_cli/adapters/base.py, registry.py, codex.py, codex_parity_gate.py, omp.py, omp_parity_gate.py, runtime/drivers/codex/probe.py, export.py, mcp.py, and runtime/release_surface.py against git log for those files since the 2026-07-05 doc snapshot
drift_verification.conclusion: OMP parity gate (T009) unchanged and resolved: OmpAdapter.fidelity_tier='native', OMP ExportResult.fidelity='native'; z-execute/z-consult/z-gate/z-panel native; all other families degraded. Codex parity gate is now two-tier (command PARITY_EVIDENCE + native_subagent_dispatch runtime primitive) via codex_parity_gate.py, which was underdocumented in the 2026-07-05 snapshot (no codex_parity_gate.py entry point, no COMMAND_RUNTIME_PRIMITIVES mention). base.py's register_command_tiers/command_tier gained a tier_provider mechanism (COMMAND_CAPABILITY_PROVIDERS) enabling live-gate reads, also undocumented previously. Three follow-up commits after the 2026-07-05 snapshot (f256decb, 19f141f9, 8af644d3) hardened runtime/drivers/codex/mcp.py: idempotency now compares full desired state and remove+re-adds on mismatch, patches approval_mode/tool-filter TOML keys post-add (no CLI flag exists), and the exported MCP surface is narrowed to enabled_tools=['z_detect'] with default_tools_approval_mode='approve' — none of this was reflected in the prior doc. registry.py's select() also now filters/orders auto-selection through runtime/release_surface.py's public_release_hosts() under the prod surface; that mechanism existed as of the 2026-07-05 snapshot's gotchas line but the module itself was not a covered source file or cross-ref.
